about: Top of the Hill is a family-owned burger shack at 2444 Lakewood Dr in Bryan.

It serves old-fashioned, hand-pressed greasy burgers with fresh-cut vegetables, and it was featured on The Texas Bucket List. People happily drive twenty minutes or more from Bryan and College Station for these burgers.
